title: Prime Minister congratulates H.E. President Hakainde Hichilema on re-election as President of Zambia
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has extended his heartiest congratulations to President H.E. Hakainde Hichilema on his re-election as the President of Zambia.
The Prime Minister said that India greatly values its multifaceted partnership with Zambia.
Shri Modi expressed his desire to work together with President Hakainde Hichilema to further strengthen the relations between India and Zambia under his leadership.
The Prime Minister said in a X post;
“Heartiest Congratulations to President Hakainde Hichilema on being re-elected as the President of Zambia.
India greatly values its multifaceted partnership with Zambia and I look forward to working together to further strengthen our relations under his leadership.
@HHichilema”
Heartiest Congratulations to President Hakainde Hichilema on being re-elected as the President of Zambia. enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Hakainde Hichilema on his re-election as President of Zambia. Modi highlighted India's multifaceted partnership with Zambia and expressed a desire to strengthen bilateral ties further. The message was conveyed via a post on X (formerly Twitter).
enrichment.context: This is a routine diplomatic courtesy message extended by the Indian Prime Minister to a foreign head of state following an election result, a standard practice in international diplomacy to maintain and signal goodwill in bilateral relations. India has longstanding ties with Zambia, rooted in shared Non-Aligned Movement history, developmental cooperation, and a significant Indian diaspora in Zambia. Such congratulatory messages typically do not carry new policy content but reaffirm existing diplomatic relationships.
